why_it_fits: Customer Support match. 2 skills: excel, customer service. Likely PH eligibility signal

position_overview: Responsibilities | Provide professional support to clients via WhatsApp and phone calls, understanding their travel needs. . Recommend destinations, packages, and services that match client preferences and budgets. . Handle bookings for flights, hotels, insurance, and related services . . Manage reservations using Sabre GDS (flights) and hotel systems such as TBO Holidays . Sabre GDS TBO Holidays. Prepare and present customized travel packages . . Oversee payments and client records with accuracy and confidentiality. . Resolve issues, complaints, or itinerary changes in a professional manner. . Meet and exceed monthly sales & profit targets . . Requirements | Minimum 2 years of proven experience in a travel agency or tourism company. . Hands-on expertise in Sabre GDS (flight bookings). Sabre GDS . Experience with hotel booking platforms (TBO Holidays or similar). TBO Holidays . Strong English communication skills (other languages are a plus). ( ). Ability to communicate fluently in Khaleeji (Gulf) or Lebanese dialect for effective client interaction. . Excellent customer service & communication skills (mainly via phone/WhatsApp). ( ). Ability to work under pressure , especially during peak travel seasons. . Personal travel experience is an added advantage. . Originally posted on Himalayas
